dependent_blockers.detail: The six per-task NPZ files contain no per-task energy field.
task_met/done and JSON completion represent deadline success, not an eventual physical-completion event.
V2I/V2V action selections can have no eligible target; transfer claims require eligibility-aware treatment.
build_trace.py writes dt=1.0 and TrafficTwin must independently reject non-one-second input.
The reviewed builder contains fixed Drakewell sensor locations; arbitrary networks need explicit placement inputs or a validated separate step.
The evaluator prepends a fixed ~/scratch source path; a safe runner must control and verify import resolution.
No licence/CITATION file was found; publication must remain within Randy's written sanitized-sample/aggregate permission.
